learning_objective: 🎯 Step into the spotlight and learn how to confidently share your beautiful art, music, or acting with a live audience!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A performance is that magical moment when you share your hard work with others! Whether you are singing a song, acting in a play, or showing a painting, it is your special time to shine and tell your story.

Even the greatest artists practice over and over before a big show. Rehearsing helps you remember your lines or notes perfectly and makes you feel incredibly strong and prepared when the curtain goes up.
When you perform, you are giving a wonderful gift to the audience. By looking at them, smiling brightly, and expressing real emotions, you help them feel the magic of your art right in their hearts!

fun_activity.title: 🪞 The Mirror Rehearsal
fun_activity.instructions: Stand in front of a mirror and practice reciting your favorite poem or singing a song. Remember to smile widely, use big expressive hand gestures, and stand up very tall and proud!

quick_recap: ⭐ Performing is a beautiful and brave way to share your unique creativity and hard work with others.
⭐ Lots of practice and a positive attitude turn nervous butterflies into an exciting, unforgettable stage show!
